description: Compact committed audit of per-launch NCU repeatability sweeps for cells that fail the schema-pinned stddev_l2_sector <= 0.03 admission gate. The audit pins the aggregate mean/stddev observed across a round's 5-repeat (or larger) NCU label sweep so subsequent rounds inherit the per-cell variance history without having to re-run the gate to confirm an unfix-by-retry verdict. The per-launch NCU sidecars (label_<r>_<launch>.json) themselves are gitignored under data/local_labels/sm_86/*/trace_l2_accuracy_xl/label_*_*.json per the broader .gitignore wildcard (preserving the local-label quarantine; only aggregate evidence is tracked).

entries.verdict_summary: attempted_excluded(ncu_repeatability_fail); variance is inherent to the warm/cold paired-relaunch kernel design (cold launch sees fresh DRAM read, warm launch sees whatever survived the inter-launch eviction; the eviction interval is sensitive to L2 controller scheduling and is not stabilized by warmup).

entries.kernel_signature_discrepancy_note: The trace JSON's kernel_signature_sha256 (a99c593c...) and the locally-computed fallback_legacy kernel signature both differ from the cohort_manifest identity tuple's recorded value (289ea530...). The R37 sweep used fallback_legacy, matching the trace JSON. A future round may need to either restamp the manifest identity to the trace-derived value OR derive a producer-side measurement_manifest that carries the correct kernel_signature_sha256.
entries.verdict_summary: attempted_excluded(ncu_repeatability_fail); cp.async issues a non-cache-pollution barrier between the global load and the shared-memory commit, and the shared-memory hit-rate distribution depends on warp scheduling order which is not stabilized by warmup at the small (rows=32, cols=32) default shape.

entries.kernel_signature_discrepancy_note: Identical pattern to cp_async_shared_tile_copy: trace-derived kernel signature (02b553b4...) disagrees with manifest identity-tuple (9ba72d7f...). A future round may need to restamp.
entries.verdict_summary: attempted_excluded(ncu_repeatability_fail); the strided-read bank-conflict pass has a controlled-throughput inner loop but the outer L2 hit rate depends on which subset of strided reads cross the L1->L2 boundary, and that subset is sensitive to thread block scheduling order.

substitute_candidates_evaluated_r37.note: default correctness shape rows=8 hidden=128 too small for stable cache measurement
closest to passing the 0.03 gate; rejects shape overrides in correctness mode (R26 presence-boolean tracking), preventing the R25 timing-shape-override pattern from being applied at correctness_shape
R35 attempt also failed with stddev=0.118
one repeat hit NCU parse_ncu_metrics ncu_csv_metric_out_of_range saturation; only 4 of 5 sidecars admissible

verdict_summary: All 3 Codex R36 directive #1 primary candidates fail the unchanged 0.03 gate with the same verdict as R20. Codex R36 directive #2 fallback path (admit a new sm_86-compatible workload cell) was attempted via 10 substitute correctness_shape candidates from portable_lcd binaries; ALL exceed the 0.03 gate. The silu_fwd_bf16_sm80/correctness_shape admission (R20+ legacy) remains the only admitted correctness_shape evidence; its 15-repeat aggregate stddev=0.017 reflects an unusually stable elementwise kernel. The remaining unadmitted dl_primitives correctness_shape candidates have small-shape kernel variance that does not stabilize under additional warmup. Path forward (Codex R36 directive #3): extend portable_lcd shape CLI to admit larger stable shape points for the depth-first six (flash_attn_fwd/bwd, swiglu_fwd, gemm_hmma_bf16/fp16, gemm_imma_int8). This requires source-side shape-override broadening AND a new round of trace + label work.
